name: file-edit
description: Edit a file by exact-string replacement. old_string must match exactly once (whitespace included) unless --replace-all. Supports atomic multi-edit via a JSON array, and --dry-run to preview a unified diff.
use_when: making a targeted edit inside an existing file

args.name: --old
args.description: Exact string to find (copy from a fresh read).

args.name: --edits
args.description: JSON file or '-' stdin: [{old, new, replace_all?}] applied atomically in order.

stdout: JSON {path, edits_applied, replacements, diff} — or just the diff with --dry-run.

exit_codes.1: no match / ambiguous match / I/O error

notes: 0 matches = re-read the file (whitespace/tabs differ). N matches = widen context or use --replace-all. Never rebuild files from truncated reads.
